title: ExecutiveSummary
description: Workspace-level executive summary returned by GET /api/workspace/summary?windowHours=N. Folds per-task protocols, supervisor advisories, orchestrator decisions, merged commits, and crash markers into one short read covering the last N hours. Default window is 24 hours; supported values are 1, 6, 24, and 168. The summary never invents events: every entry under byProject, topDecisions, crashes, and openHumanDecisions references an underlying record by id, sha, or job key.

windowStart.description: UTC start of the summary window. Inclusive.

windowEnd.description: UTC end of the summary window. Exclusive. Typically 'now' aligned to the producing clock.

headline.description: One-sentence readable summary of the window. Plain prose, no markdown emphasis. Renders as the page title on #/summary. Producer must answer 'what is the most important thing that happened in this window' in 240 characters or less.

byProject.description: One entry per watched project that had any activity in the window. Empty array when the workspace was idle.

project.description: Project name as it appears in WatchPaths.

jobsMoved.description: Job lane transitions observed in the window.

decisionsMade.description: Count of orchestrator/review decisions recorded in logs/decisions/<project>.jsonl in the window.

advisoriesRaised.description: Count of supervisor advisories appended to logs/meta/<project>/observations.jsonl in the window.

commits.description: Commits whose author date falls inside the window. Only commits in the project's repository, never in the workspace's job folders.

crashes.description: References to last-crash.json entries whose timestamp falls inside the window. References only; the consumer reads the actual crash record from disk.

kind.description: Origin of the crash record: 'unhandled', 'unobserved-task', 'crash-recovery', 'orphan-recovery', or any other tag the producer wrote.

path.description: Workspace-relative path to the crash record on disk so the reader can open it without ambiguity.

summary.description: Optional one-line readable description copied from the source record.

topDecisions.description: Up to ~10 most load-bearing decisions in the window, weighted by severity. Each entry is a reference into logs/decisions/<project>.jsonl, never an inlined copy.

severity.description: Severity used for ranking. The aggregator sorts by severity desc, then timestamp desc.

title.description: One-line title of the decision, copied verbatim from the source record.

jobId.description: Job this decision pertains to, when applicable.

openHumanDecisions.description: Tasks currently sitting in 1-preparation whose slug matches the prefix 'human-decision-needed-'. These are the questions the user has not answered yet. Independent of the window: an open decision is open regardless of when it was raised.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version. Producers may omit; consumers must default missing values to '1'.
